messages:
Alex K: Heads up — scheduling a staggered IO firmware upgrade on GPU racks in eu-west-2 and us-central1 next week. This is an NVMe controller firmware update; required by vendor for stability and perf regressions.
Priya R: Rough impact on capacity? any calc for token throughput loss?
Alex K: Expecting ~12-18% GPU capacity offline during each region window (we're doing 2 racks at a time). Short reboots + controller init = ~25–35m per rack. We'll limit to 2 racks concurrently to keep latency SLOs.
Sam (oncall): Oncall availability confirmed for the windows. I can do coordination and kicked alerts. Which hours are you thinking?
Marco L: Proposing staggered windows to avoid global double-hit: eu-west-2 on Tue 00:30–04:00 UTC, us-central1 on Wed 02:00–06:00 UTC. That keeps weekdays low-traffic for both.
Jenna P: Can we avoid scheduled jobs / batch training in those windows? I'll ping ML infra to quiesce long batches and postpone nightly evals.
Carlos M: Routing note — we'll use routing policy 'latency-prefer' but fallback to 'cost-fallback' if capacity dips >15%. Should we pre-warm extra instances in us-central1? That will increase cost but reduce tail latency.
Priya R: Pre-warm proposal + cost estimate please. If we spin up 4 extra p4d nodes for 6 hours in us-central1 that's ~ $Xk. Alternative: reduce batch sizes during window to preserve latency at lower cost.
Alex K: Plan A = pre-warm 4 nodes for 6h during maintenance windows. Plan B = throttle batcher to 40% and enable aggressive prefix caching for infer-prod. Leaning Plan B unless product asks for headroom.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket #MN-4521 created: https://redwood.internal/maint/MN-4521 — automated notice sent to infra-notify.
sre-bot: FYI — automated healthcheck will mark workers as DRAINING before the firmware step. Will post final status when drains complete.
Marco L: Operational steps (short):
```
fleetctl set-drain --region eu-west-2 --racks rack-12,rack-13 --timeout 45m
kubectl drain node/gpu-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --force
shipctl fw-upgrade --target rack-12 --image nvme-fw-2.1.0
fleetctl set-online --region eu-west-2 --racks rack-12
```
Priya R: Any manual rollback? vendor says rollback is possible but takes ~20m and needs a cold power cycle. That's ugly.
Alex K: Agree — we'll keep a 30m hold period after upgrade before marking racks live in the pool. If healthchecks fail, we rollback and move to next rack after triage.
Sam (oncall): I'll create PagerDuty escalation for the window and a short runbook in the ticket. Also adding a slack alert channel #infra-maint-ops.
Jenna P: Quick ask — update the console dashboard to show 'maintenance capacity' so SRE/Support can see reduced available GPUs. Without it support will page unnecessarily.
Carlos M: Also toggling routing to prefer Dedicated pools for orgs with reserved capacity to avoid breaking enterprise SLAs.
Priya R: After the work, can we run a perf regression test (10k token gen across 3 models) and store results in perf-bench for rollback gating?
Alex K: Yes — perf-bench job will run automatically post-upgrade. If latency or cost delta > 8% we will revert.
Marco L: Final schedule in ticket:
- Tue 00:30 UTC: begin eu-west-2 rack-12/13 drain
- Tue 01:15 UTC: firmware apply rack-12
- Tue 01:50 UTC: bring rack-12 back to pool; hold 30m
- Tue 02:30 UTC: firmware apply rack-13
- Tue 03:05 UTC: bring rack-13 back; run perf-bench
- Wed 02:00 UTC: same flow for us-central1 (racks 5/6)
Alex K: Thanks all. I'll publish the short customer comms blurb once we lock times. Ping me in-thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Sam (oncall): Adding automated post-upgrade checklists and will stand by.
Carlos M: Noted — cost bump for pre-warm option logged in MN-4521 but defaulting to throttle + caching.
Priya R: Cool. I'll coordinate ML infra and then mark approvals in the ticket.
Alex K: Closing loop — will post a final 'starting' msg 30m before each window and 'done' after perf-bench.
note: This thread contains the initial maintenance plan and follow-up coordination messages for a staggered IO firmware upgrade across regions.
